rationale_one_line: Mario Zechner ships terminal-native, anti-framework tooling. Mono-terminal mirrors the build-in-public hacker register and matrix-green accent matches the CLI surface pi-mono lives on.
writing_tone_notes: Bold declarative peer voice. Build-in-public, anti-framework instinct. Dry, minimal, no marketing. Refrain on minimal core. Show the contrast between framework kits and a hand-wired monorepo. Admiring without compliments.
do_rules: Open with the project name and the angle in the same beat
Use the stack scene to enumerate the three real packages
Land the fix on minimal core and let it breathe
Close with a refrain that earns the rewatch
dont_rules: No questions, hooks, hashtags, em or en dashes, semicolons, arrows, or emojis
No flattery. The work flatters itself
No framework jargon (orchestration, runtime, harness as nouns)
No claims unverifiable from the README
